about_the_game:
Seafrog is a 2.5D action-platformer mashed with the movement of lite-skateboarding. Grind, kick-flip and find the flow with a rocket-powered wrench that moves smoother than a buttered beluga!

A SEA-SLICK PLATFORMER

String together combos by using a simple auto-trick system, landing grinds on fat rats and rusty pipes to fuel up your rocket-wrench! Use the fuel to boost through enemies, fly straight up walls, and stick to ceilings in order to complete over 100 handcrafted challenges!

EXPLORE RUN DOWN SHIPS

Each chapter in Seafrog is based on a ships theme. Battle vengeful Viking ghosts aboard the Sea Dragon. Dig in for an unsavory meal aboard the Chunky Chacken, where you’ll discover a man-eating chicken outbreak. Finally, get ready for some monkey business at The Sweater Factory, an abandoned workshop run by an unexpected crew of apes causing all the ruckus. Each chapter holds a Master Gear, guarded by an ultimate boss.

MASTER GEAR, HO!

Battle the legendary Skraken, Metal Beak the Momma Chacken, and... Gerald. Face these colorful 'n crusty foes to retrieve the Master Gears and repair your cannon. Blast yourself to a stranded seaplane to escape the seahole, a mysterious sinking hole in the ocean… before ye end up in Davy Jones' Locker!

FEATURES LIST

  • 8-10 hours of story campaign featuring multiple boss encounters to test your moves.

  • Interact with a colorful cast of characters suitable for all ages.

  • Collect and Combine 24 Mod Chips to customize your play, adjust them for more relaxed play or crank up your stats for a more difficult challenge.

  • Use your C-Star navigation device to achieve 100% item collection in every map location.

  • Scour every room to uncover over 120 hidden Snakestones.

  • Beat the campaign and solve the mystery of the seahole.

short_description: Master Seafrog's rocket-powered wrench as you slide, grind and trick your way through challenging skatepark-like stages at sea! Upgrade your wrench, take on crusty creatures and crazy challenges, all while seeking a way to escape a mysterious, ever-growing sinkhole in the ocean...
